_comment: The harness size budget (Round 3 / W7, ADR-H288). The TOTAL is the binding constraint; the per-module ratchet lives in python/tests/test_size_budget.py. Raising a ceiling is allowed but must be a deliberate edit to this file - the point is that growth cannot happen silently. The V2 terminal merge removed the direct sandbox path (ADR-H311); reconciling origin/main's live-preflight and outage guards added 24 evaluation lines, so the committed ceiling is the measured merged tree.
